meta.description: VitaQueen natural mineral water — drawn from a protected mountain spring, bottled at source under continuous laboratory control.

hero.subtitle: Drawn at 2,140 m from a spring that has been filtering through mountain rock for centuries — untouched between the source and the seal.

spring.title: Spring
spring.body: Water surfaces under its own artesian pressure inside a fenced protection perimeter.

water.title: Water
water.body: It travels through stainless steel lines in a closed circuit — no pumps open to the air.

filtration.title: Filtration
filtration.body: Micro-filtration removes particles without touching the natural mineral profile.

laboratory.title: Laboratory
laboratory.body: Physical, chemical and microbiological parameters are checked on every production batch.

bottling.title: Bottling
bottling.body: Blowing, filling and capping happen in one aseptic monoblock, seconds apart.

product.title: Final product
product.body: Every pallet is traceable back to its batch, its shift and its analysis sheet.

s01.title: Born from the earth
s01.body: Rain and snowmelt take decades to travel down through the limestone. What comes back up is already mineral water — we only protect it.

s02.title: A journey through nature
s02.body: No chemical treatment, no reconstitution, no blending. The composition you read on the label is the composition of the spring.

s03.title: Protected by nature
s03.body: The catchment area sits above any farming or industrial activity, inside a legally defined protection zone.

s04.title: Pure by nature. Controlled by science.
s04.body: An in-house laboratory runs continuous physicochemical and microbiological testing, backed by accredited external labs.

s05.title: From source to bottle
s05.body: The bottling hall stands on the spring itself. The water never leaves the site before it is sealed.

sourceTeaser.title: A spring at 2,140 metres
sourceTeaser.body: Altitude, geology and a protected catchment give the water a stable mineral signature all year round.

productsTeaser.title: Five formats, one water
productsTeaser.body: From the 330 ml on-the-go bottle to the 5 L home pack — the same analysis sheet in every one.

qualityTeaser.title: Trust is measured, not claimed
qualityTeaser.body: Batch records, accredited analyses and published certificates — all of it available before you ask for it.

sustainabilityTeaser.title: Protecting what we bottle
sustainabilityTeaser.body: Source protection, energy efficiency, recyclable packaging and waste reduction — with numbers, not adjectives.

cta.title: Let's talk
cta.body: Distribution, private label or an export enquiry — our commercial team answers within two working days.

about.title: A factory built around a spring
about.lead: VitaQueen bottles natural mineral water at source. Everything else — the buildings, the lines, the laboratory — exists to keep that water exactly as the mountain delivers it.

company.title: The company
company.body: VitaQueen operates a bottling plant on its own concession, from raw water extraction through to palletised finished goods. Production, quality assurance and logistics are managed in-house.

history.title: History
history.body: Milestones from the concession survey to the current production capacity.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: To be the mineral water that specifiers, hotels and export buyers choose because its documentation is as good as its taste.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: Bottle at source, publish every analysis, and never change the water to fit a marketing story.

management.title: Management
management.body: The leadership team behind production, quality and commercial operations.

source.title: Where the water begins
source.lead: The value of a mineral water is decided long before the bottling hall. It is decided by the rock it passes through.

spring.title: Natural spring
spring.body: The spring is artesian: water reaches the surface under its own pressure, which means the aquifer stays sealed from surface contamination.

geography.title: Geography
geography.body: The catchment sits in a high mountain basin with no farming, no industry and no road traffic above the collection point.

characteristics.title: Water characteristics
characteristics.body: Measured at the wellhead. These values are stable within seasonal tolerance and are re-verified on every batch.

protection.title: Source protection
protection.body: A fenced perimeter, monitored piezometers and a legally registered protection zone keep the aquifer intact.

minerals.title: Mineral composition
minerals.body: Milligrams per litre at the wellhead.

products.title: One water, five formats
products.lead: Every format carries the same water, the same analysis and the same traceability. Only the use case changes.

factory.title: Eight stages, one continuous line
factory.lead: Scroll through the plant the way the water moves through it.

waterSource.title: Water source
waterSource.body: Extraction at the wellhead under continuous flow and pressure monitoring.

rawWater.title: Raw water
rawWater.body: Closed stainless steel transfer to buffer tanks, with no exposure to the atmosphere.

treatment.title: Treatment
treatment.body: Micro-filtration cascade down to 0.2 µm. Nothing is added, nothing that belongs to the water is removed.

qualityControl.title: Quality control
qualityControl.body: In-line sampling before filling: conductivity, pH, turbidity and microbiology.

bottling.title: Bottling
bottling.body: Blow-fill-cap monoblock. Preform to sealed bottle in a single enclosed cycle.

packaging.title: Packaging
packaging.body: Labelling, date coding, shrink wrapping and palletising with batch identification.

warehouse.title: Warehouse
warehouse.body: Quarantine until the batch release certificate is signed by the laboratory.

distribution.title: Distribution
distribution.body: Dispatch to domestic distributors and export containers, fully traceable per pallet.

quality.title: Trust is a document, not an adjective
quality.lead: For a mineral water, credibility matters more than animation. Everything on this page can be verified.

control.title: Quality control
control.body: Sampling plan, in-process checks and batch release. No pallet leaves quarantine without a signed certificate of analysis.

laboratory.title: Laboratory
laboratory.body: The on-site laboratory runs physicochemical and microbiological testing on every shift, cross-checked periodically by accredited external laboratories.

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.body: Only certificates that are currently held and verifiable are listed here.

analysis.title: Water analysis
analysis.body: Full analysis at the wellhead. Values in mg/L unless stated otherwise.

quality.empty: Certificates are being updated. Please contact us for the current documentation.

sustainability.title: Protecting what we bottle
sustainability.lead: A mineral water company that damages its own catchment has no product in twenty years. This is self-interest as much as ethics.

p01.title: Source protection
p01.body: Fenced perimeter, piezometric monitoring and a legally registered protection zone around the catchment.

p02.title: Energy efficiency
p02.body: Heat recovery on the blowing line, high-efficiency compressors and on-site solar generation.

p03.title: Recyclable packaging
p03.body: Mono-material PET bottles and caps, lighter preforms and recyclable stretch film.

p04.title: Waste reduction
p04.body: Segregated production waste, reprocessed PET scrap and reduced water use per litre bottled.

metrics.title: Measured, not claimed
metrics.body: Figures are published once they are verified for a full production year.

export.title: Built for international buyers
export.lead: Documentation, packaging and lead times prepared for container-load export.

markets.title: Export markets
markets.body: Current and target destinations for containerised shipments.

privateLabel.title: Private label
privateLabel.body: Your brand, our source. Artwork, format and case configuration to your specification, with the same analysis and traceability.

packaging.title: Export packaging
packaging.body: Case counts, pallet patterns and container loading plans available on request.

contact.title: International contact
contact.body: Send us your destination, format and target volume — we reply with a quotation and a documentation pack.

distributors.title: Representatives & partners
distributors.lead: Find your regional distributor, or apply to become one.
distributors.empty: The distributor list is being updated. Please contact us directly.

contact.title: Talk to the people who run the line
contact.lead: Commercial, quality and export enquiries reach the responsible team directly.
